subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a cron timeline/calendar view in core now, and if so should this contributor branch be rebased and repaired or replaced with a fresh implementation on the current cron page?
rationale: The linked feature issue remains a product-direction item, and the branch now needs substantial rebase plus correctness work rather than a narrow mechanical patch.

options.title: Rebase and repair this branch
options.body: Keep the contributor's visual timeline direction, but require a current-main rebase plus fixes for status fields, scheduler parity, real status colors, and generated locales before merge.

options.title: Replace with a fresh implementation
options.body: Use this PR as design/proof input but implement the timeline directly against the current `ui/src/pages/cron/*` architecture in a new branch.

options.title: Pause on the linked issue
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged and continue product/design discussion on the canonical cron calendar issue before sponsoring implementation.

recommendation.title: Rebase and repair this branch
recommendation.body: Keep the contributor's visual timeline direction, but require a current-main rebase plus fixes for status fields, scheduler parity, real status colors, and generated locales before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main cron status and cron Control UI changes make this the strongest available owner for both product fit and rebase direction.
